readme_probe.readme_statement: The delivery contains CDF files generated from raw TOBI files, relevant .nav/.cable files for PRISM, processed ascii EM12 bathymetry files, and navigation products for both cruise legs.

navigation.format: YY JULIAN_DAY HH:MM:SS LAT FLAG LON FLAG

external_cruise_report_context.raw_line_storage_context: The cruise report describes raw EM12 acquisition copied to Mermaid on line-number changes under cruise ID CD169.
external_cruise_report_context.delivery_limitation: Those raw per-line files are not present in the inspected sd11281 BODC delivery.
external_cruise_report_context.processing_context: The cruise report states newly acquired EM12 data were processed and bathymetry was merged with existing data for some mapping products.

authoritative_interpretation: Acceptl*.xyz.ascii must be treated as processed bathymetry products, not raw beam records.
Filename line-group labels are useful provenance hints but do not prove point-level raw-line identity.
Any temporal mismatch diagnostic based on these XYZ products must preserve this product-lineage limitation.
